conclusions.evidence: Positional reuse requires full actual Item equality. Name relocation is only an optional old-slot lookup, with disjoint function/global/type name domains and a second full Item equality test before old text is reused. A duplicate name can make the borrowed index choose a nonmatching last slot and repaint conservatively; equal duplicates may still safely reuse exactly equal payload. Names, borrowed pointers or a digest alone do not authorize output. Every current item remains present in current order.

Both current item and fragment roots are cloned locally and truncated to the same current count. Exact positional matches retain both old leaves. Relocated or changed slots update the paired item owner and its own text fragment at the same index; additions append both. The old roots are immutable, and borrowed name/index iterators are dropped before paired fields are installed. Source mutation cannot change an older DiagnosticText or session checkpoint. DiagnosticText retained in an older partition product has its own complete immutable fragment root; it is not assumed to be the current render cache.

Header is freshly generated from current triple/fingerprint and an empty module via the unchanged formatter. Cached partition diagnostics keep complete old text/fragments but substitute only the current fingerprint value in the fixed header, preserving its newline and complete suffix. Absent/nonmatching header falls back to complete original text, matching previous behavior; no fragment or header tail is discarded.

A single64-IoSlice metadata vector borrows immutable header and payload bytes. Empty chunks are filtered, all nonempty chunks are ordered and exhausted, and each batch repeats until all its bytes are consumed. Short writes advance exact slice offsets with IoSlice::advance_slices; Interrupted retries the same remaining bytes; zero progress yields WriteZero; other write errors and final flush errors propagate. Standard Write fallback handles scalar-only writers without skipping later slices. There is no1MiB payload aggregation or retained filesystem receipt.
